title: Show HN posts stories vs hands-on making stories on points
question: Does a story about Show HN posts get more points than a story about hands-on making?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Show HN posts gets more points than a story about hands-on making.
expect: If true, points per story for Show HN posts stories should be at least 1.5x the value for hands-on making stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Show HN posts against hands-on making

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h367 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h367 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
